newsitem.title: CHINA: Malaysia's Perwaja Terengganu seeks US$400 mln.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Perwaja Terengganu seeks US$400 mln.

text.p: Malaysian steelmaker Perwaja Terengganu Sdn Bhd's US$400 million five-year floating-rate note (FRN) is now in general syndication, one of the co-arrangers said on Thursday.
It said the arranger was Standard Chartered Bank, with DKB Asia, IBJ Asia, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and JP Morgan Securities Asia coming in as co-arrangers.

It confirmed also that the issue had been launched at two levels, both for a participation fee of five basis points, with managers being invited to commit US$20 million or more, and co-managers US$10 million.
The co-arranger did not give further details of the borrowing or its purpose.
